newsitem.title: CHINA: Gujing expects rise in first-half net.
newsitem.headline: Gujing expects rise in first-half net.

text.p: China's Anhui Gujing Distillery Co Ltd expects its 1997 interim net profits to reach 140 million yuan, against 134 million yuan in the year-ago period, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
The earnings advance was fuelled by an increase in sales of alcholic drinks, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The profit figures were calculated under Chinese accounting standards, the official said. He declined to give figures using international standards.
Gujing expected 1997 net profits to register a year-on-year rise of 10 percent on sales of about one billion yuan based on Chinese accounting standards, the official said.
The company posted net profits of 174 million yuan for 1996 under Chinese standards.
Gujing, based in eastern Anhui province, listed 60 million B shares in Shenzhen in June last year, followed by a listing of 18 million A shares last September.
